doc.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Neal Hefti sits in on trumpet
summary: Neal Hefti played trumpet again after 30 years, sitting in with Ross and Jack Sheldon.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Neal came and played his trumpet with me last Sunday night.
It was the first time in 30 years. He got his trumpet, he went to Uan Rasey for a week, and he came and sat in with Jack Sheldon and myself at the Money Tree last Sunday
night. He said, “This is the first time I’ve played in 30 years.” He got himself a brand new beautiful trumpet.
And he wrote down, these are five songs I can play: “Might as Well be Spring,” “L’il Darlin’” but he had a great time.
